recipes.name: Maple-Glazed Acorn Squash
sentences: Preheat oven to 350°.
Place cut side down in a 13x9-in. baking dish; add water.
Bake, uncovered, for 45 minutes.
Bake, uncovered, 10 minutes or until glaze is heated through.

recipes.name: Cake & Berry Campfire Cobbler
ingredients: 2 cans (21 ounces each) raspberry pie filling
sentences: Prepare grill or campfire for low heat, using 16-20 charcoal briquettes or large wood chips.
When briquettes or wood chips are covered with white ash, place Dutch oven directly on top of 8-10 of them.
Cook until filling is bubbly and a toothpick inserted in the topping comes out clean, 30-40 minutes.

recipes.name: Dirt Cake
ingredients: 2 packages (3.4 ounces each) instant vanilla pudding mix
1 carton (12 ounces) frozen whipped topping, thawed
Optional: Gummy worms and shaved white chocolate
sentences: Spread 1-1/3 cups crushed Oreos into an ungreased 13x9-inch dish.

recipes.name: Candy Bar Freezer Dessert
ingredients: 2 packages (3.4 ounces each) instant vanilla pudding mix
4 cups butter pecan ice cream, softened
1 carton (8 ounces) frozen whipped topping, thawed
sentences: Pat three-fourths of the mixture into an ungreased 13-in. x 9-in. dish.
In a large bowl, whisk milk and pudding mixes for 2 minutes or until thickened.
Cover and freeze for at least 2 hours.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Bananas Foster
ingredients: Optional: Vanilla ice cream or sliced pound cake
sentences: Cut bananas in half lengthwise, then widthwise; layer in the bottom of a 1-1/2-qt. slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low until heated through, about 1-1/2 hours.
Sprinkle with walnuts and coconut; cook 30 minutes longer.

recipes.name: Ham Loaf
sentences: Begin by heating the oven to 350°F.
Press the ham mixture into a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Place the pan in the hot oven, and bake the loaf for 30 minutes.
Once the loaf has baked for 30 minutes, pull it from the oven, and spoon the glaze over the top.
Put the ham loaf back in the oven, and bake for an additional 40 minutes, until a thermometer reads 145°F in the center, basting occasionally with glaze.
It's best if you let the finished ham loaf rest for at least 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Mexican Rice Salad
ingredients: 1 can (15 ounces) black beans, rinsed and drained
sentences: Reduce the heat, cover the pan, and simmer the rice for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Broccoli Ham Ring
ingredients: 2 tubes (8 ounces each) refrigerated crescent roll dough
1/4 pound boneless fully cooked ham, cubed
sentences: Unroll crescent roll dough and place triangles on a 12-in. pizza pan, forming a ring with pointed ends facing outer edge of pan and wide ends overlapping.
Bake at 375° for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.name: Cheesy Broccoli Rigatoni
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked rigatoni or large tube pasta
2 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese, divided
sentences: Meanwhile, in a large saucepan, saute garlic in butter over medium heat for 1 minute.
Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
In a large saucepan, bring 1 in. of water and broccoli to a boil.
Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 5-8 minutes or until crisp-tender.
In a 13x9-in. baking dish coated with cooking spray, layer 1 cup white sauce, half of the pasta and broccoli and 1/2 cup cheese.
Cover and bake at 350° for 25-30 minutes or until heated through.

recipes.name: Cornish Game Hens
ingredients: 3 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon olive oil, divided
2 pounds fresh Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved
2 small red onions, cut into wedges
sentences: Add the butter, 3 tablespoons olive oil and herbs, then cover and process until smooth.
In a 15x10x1-inch baking pan, toss the Brussels sprouts and onions with the remaining olive oil, salt and pepper.
Bake at 450°F until a thermometer inserted into the breast reads 165°, 35 to 40 minutes.
Cover them with foil and let them rest for 10 minutes before carving and serving the Cornish game hens.
